identity.real_world_identity_notes: Mid-engine GTE car with the naturally aspirated LT6.R 5.5 litre V8. Xtrac built a bespoke, unusually compact P529 six-speed sequential transaxle so the car could carry a larger rear diffuser.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: clutch-free move-off, six paddle-selected gears, and automatic cut and blip.
No throttle lift is required on upshifts and no manual blip on downshifts, because the drive detected automatic cut and automatic blip.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.chevrolet-corvette-c8-r.20260813t200108578z-68512894 by Jason Kinslow.

confidence.basis: Simulator behavior was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the Xtrac P529 six-speed sequential transaxle is supported by a registered secondary source.

claims.basis: A registered secondary source establishes the C8.R identity and its Xtrac P529 transaxle, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
The source specifies a six-speed sequential Xtrac transaxle, and the live drive confirmed six paddle-selected gears with clutch-free move-off.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.

deviations.basis: Whether the car needs a throttle lift on upshifts is not established. A guided drive settles it, by holding the throttle through an upshift and seeing whether the gear engages.

notes: The wheel-rim shape was originally recorded as "gt-style". The separate "gt-style", "formula" and "prototype" values described the same rim: molded grips at 9 and 3 with a control face between them, usually carrying a display and rev lights. They are merged into "gt-formula". The rim was not observed again and nothing about the observation changed.
